headline: Serbian President Concedes Election Defeat to Student-Led Movement
summary: Serbia's president has conceded defeat in national elections to a student-led movement. The political shift follows nearly two years of widespread demonstrations protesting state corruption and authoritarian governance.
why: Serbia is a critical Western Balkan economy and candidate for European Union accession; political changes alter regulatory, fiscal, and geopolitical alignments.

impacts.name: Serbia
impacts.why: An unexpected transfer of power introduces political uncertainty but may influence EU integration prospects and governance reforms.
